title: ROOT Harness Policy Configuration Schema
description: Defines behavioral constraints for agents: permitted operations, scope restrictions, autonomy level, LLM configuration, and tool-level approval policy. Policy enforcement is a ROOT Harness concern (execution layer), distinct from SAGE's editor-based write control (data layer). See ROOT Harness Architecture Reference Sections 4.3 and 4.4.

policies.description: Policy configurations for this domain. Each agent's policy_ref references a policy_id in this array.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy. Referenced by agent registration records via policy_ref.

description.description: What this policy is intended for and which agents typically use it.

permitted_operations.description: SAGE Core API operations this agent is permitted to call. A mechanical formatting agent might have [discover, update_metadata, ingest] but not set_lifecycle. A steward governing transitions might have [discover, traverse, check_preconditions, set_lifecycle, update_metadata].

scope_restrictions.description: Constraints on which documents the agent can operate on within its permitted operations.

doc_types.description: If specified, the agent can only operate on documents of these doc_types.

lifecycle_states.description: If specified, the agent can only operate on documents in these lifecycle states. Example: a terminology audit agent restricted to 'active' documents.

pipeline_stages.description: If specified, the agent can only operate on documents in these pipeline stages.

approval_policy.description: Tool-level approval configuration (CAS-ADR-013). Defines which tool calls require human approval before execution. The approval callback is the fine-grained complement to workflow-level interrupt nodes: interrupts gate transitions; approval callbacks gate individual tool calls within a node.

default_action.description: Default behavior for tool calls not explicitly listed in the rules. 'allow' permits execution without approval. 'require_approval' requires approval for all unlisted operations.

rules.description: Ordered list of approval rules. First matching rule wins.

operation.description: The SAGE Core API operation or MCP tool call this rule applies to. Use '*' for all operations.

action.description: allow: execute without approval. require_approval: route to human before execution. deny: block and surface denial to the agent as an error so it can adjust its approach.

condition.description: Optional condition expression for when this rule applies. Example: 'lifecycle_status == active' or 'doc_type in [design_spec, glossary]'. If omitted, the rule applies unconditionally for the named operation.

denial_response_format.description: How denials and rejections are surfaced to the agent. error_message: a plain text error. structured_feedback: a structured object with reason, suggested_alternative, and escalation_path.
